c1_blocking_reasons: Zero external datasets supply the 31 Borg 2011 telemetry features (specifically hardware counters CPI and MAI, disk I/O fraction, and assigned memory ratio).
Scaler shift: Frozen models require the Candidate A Train scaler fitted on 2011 feature distributions; applying it to external traces causes severe out-of-distribution distortion.
Label semantics: None of the external datasets contain native 3-class failure proximity labels (Class 0/1/2).

next_study_recommendation.action: Design a formal study protocol for an adapted cloud failure-prediction benchmark on Google Borg 2019.
next_study_recommendation.access_mechanism: Google BigQuery cohort extraction sandbox (single cell, 1-week window, ~1 GB export).
next_study_recommendation.comparison_restriction: Explicitly declare that newly trained models on Borg 2019 represent a new benchmark and cannot be directly compared against Phase 7S-7U Borg 2011 operational gate metrics.
